H8101.def: a Shimathite (collectively) or descendants of Shimah

H8102.derivation: from an unused root meaning to emit a sound;

H8104.def: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H8104.kjv: beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

H8105.def: something preserved, i.e. the settlings (plural only) of wine

H8106.def: Shemer, the name of three Israelites

H8108.derivation: feminine of an unused noun from H8104 (שָׁמַר) meaning a guard;

H8109.derivation: feminine of passive participle of H8104 (שָׁמַר);

H8110.derivation: from H8105 (שֶׁמֶר) in its original sense; guardianship;
H8110.def: Shimron, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine

H8111.derivation: from the active participle of H8104 (שָׁמַר); watch-station;

H8112.derivation: from H8110 (שִׁמְרוֹן) and a derivative of H4754 (מָרָא); guard of lashing;

H8113.derivation: from H8105 (שֶׁמֶר) in its original sense; watchful;
H8113.def: Shimri, the name of four Israelites

H8114.derivation: or שְׁמַרְיָהוּ; from H8104 (שָׁמַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has guarded;
H8114.def: Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites

H8117.def: a Shimronite (collectively) or descendants of Shimron

H8118.def: a Shomeronite (collectively) or inhabitants of Shomeron

H8120.derivation: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ) through the idea of activity implied in day-light;

H8121.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be brilliant;
H8121.def: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H8121.kjv: [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also H1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ).

H8126.derivation: patronymically from an unused name from H7762 (שׁוּם) probably meaning garlic-smell;
H8126.def: a Shumathite (collectively) or descendants of Shumah

H8127.def: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff

H8134.derivation: probably from H8132 (שָׁנָא) and H1 (אָב); a father has turned;

H8138.def: to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive)
H8138.kjv: do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time.

H8141.def: a year (as a revolution of time)

H8143.derivation: from H8127 (שֵׁן) and the plural apparently of a foreign word;
H8143.def: probably, tooth of elephants, i.e. ivory tusk

H8144.def: crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it

H8145.def: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again

H8147.kjv: both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

H8149.derivation: or שְׂנִיר; from an unused root meaning to be pointed; peak;
H8149.def: Shenir or Senir, a summit of Lebanon

H8150.def: to point (transitive or intransitive); intensively, to pierce; figuratively, to inculcate

H8156.def: to split or tear; figuratively, to upbraid

H8158.def: to cut in pieces, i.e. slaughter

H8159.def: to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered
H8159.kjv: depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.

H8160.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H8159 (שָׁעָה);
H8160.def: properly, a look, i.e. a moment

H8161.derivation: feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp;

H8162.def: linsey-woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together
H8162.kjv: garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen.

H8163.def: shaggy; as noun, a he-goat; by analogy, a faun
H8163.kjv: devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr.

H8165.def: Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine

H8168.derivation: from an unused root meaning to hollow out;
H8168.def: the palm; by extension, a handful

H8169.derivation: or שַׁעֲלַבִּין; plural from H7776 (שׁוּעָל); fox-holes;
H8169.def: Shaalbim or Shaalabbin, a place in Palestine

H8170.def: a Shaalbonite or inhabitant of Shaalbin

H8172.kjv: lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay.

H8173.def: (in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), i.e. fondle, please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), i.e. stare
H8173.kjv: cry (out) (by confusion with H7768 (שָׁוַע)), dandle, delight (self), play, shut.

H8174.def: Shaaph, the name of two Israelites

H8175.def: to storm; by implication, to shiver, i.e. fear
H8175.kjv: be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind.

H8176.derivation: a primitive root; to split or open, i.e. (literally, but only as denominative from H8179 (שַׁעַר)); compare see H7778 (שׁוֹעֵר)
H8176.def: to act as gatekeeper; (figuratively) to estimate

H8178.kjv: affrighted, [idiom] horribly, [idiom] sore, storm. See H8181 (שֵׂעָר).

H8179.derivation: from H8176 (שָׁעַר) in its original sense;
H8179.def: an opening, i.e. door or gate

H8181.derivation: or שַׂעַר; (Isaiah 7:20), from H8175 (שָׂעַר) in the sense of dishevelling;

H8184.derivation: or שְׂעוֹרָה (feminine meaning the plant); and (masculine meaning the grain); also שְׂעֹר; or שְׂעוֹר; from H8175 (שָׂעַר) in the sense of roughness;

H8186.derivation: or שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה; or שַׁעֲרֻרִת; feminine from H8176 (שָׁעַר) in the sense of H8175 (שָׂעַר);

H8187.derivation: from H8176 (שָׁעַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has stormed;

H8188.derivation: masculine plural of H8184 (שְׂעֹרָה); barley grains;

H8193.derivation: or (in dual and plural) שֶׂפֶת; probably from H5595 (סָפָה) or H8192 (שָׁפָה) through the idea of termination (compare H5490 (סוֹף));
H8193.def: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H8193.kjv: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.

H8194.derivation: from H8192 (שָׁפָה) in the sense of clarifying;
H8194.def: a cheese (as strained from the whey)

H8195.derivation: or שְׁפִי; from H8192 (שָׁפָה); baldness (compare H8205 (שְׁפִי));

H8197.derivation: or שְׁפוּפָן; from the same as H8207 (שְׁפִיפֹן); serpent-like;

H8198.derivation: feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see H4940 (מִשְׁפָּחָה));
H8198.def: a female slave (as a member of the household)

H8199.def: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H8199.kjv: [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule.
